_meta.label: English
_meta.note: The reference catalogue. Every key here should exist in every other locale; `indiedeck locales check` reports the gaps. Registry-sourced text (compat rule messages, engine names, config setting labels) is NOT listed here - it lives in registry/ in English and other locales override it under the compat.* / registry.* / configSchema.* prefixes.

font-bundle-mismatch.message: TMP font bundle(s) present ({installed}) but none matches Unity {unityVersion} - translated text will render as blank boxes.
font-bundle-mismatch.fix: Install {bundle} and point FallbackFontTextMeshPro at it.

font-bundle-clutter.message: {count} TMP font bundle(s) for other Unity versions are sitting in the game folder ({unused}).
font-bundle-clutter.fix: Only {bundle} is used here; the rest are dead weight.

loaders-stacked.message: {count} mod loaders are installed at once: {loaders}.
loaders-stacked.fix: Keep the one the translator actually uses; ReiPatcher in particular is documented as incompatible with other plugin managers.

translator-payload-orphaned.message: {translator} files for the "{variant}" variant are installed, but no loader providing "{capability}" is present - nothing will load them.
translator-payload-orphaned.fix: Install the matching loader, or remove the stray files and install the variant that fits the loader you have.

translator-outdated.message: {translator} {installed} installed; {latest} is the newest known release.

translator-endpoint-too-old.message: {translator} {installed} predates the 5.5.2 DeepL auth fix; the DeepL API will reject its requests.
translator-endpoint-too-old.fix: Upgrade to 5.5.2 or newer, or switch endpoint.

translator-input-system-too-old.message: {translator} {installed} predates the UnityInput change in 5.5.1; in-game hotkeys will not respond in this new-Input-System game.

engine-version-unknown.message: Unity version could not be read, so version-gated compatibility checks are advisory only for this game.

translator-payload-orphaned.evidence-message: {translator} payload files are present, but no loader able to run them is installed.

translator-duplicate-install.message: {translator} payloads from several loader families are present ({variants}); only one can load.
translator-duplicate-install.fix: Clean up the duplicates, then reinstall the variant that matches this game.

translator-multi-version.message: {translator} files report several versions ({versions}); which one loads is not decidable from disk alone.
translator-multi-version.fix: Clean up and reinstall a single version.

translator-managed-drift.message: {translator} does not match its IndieDeck record (receipt {receipt}, files report {found}).
translator-managed-drift.fix: Review the changed files, then run a repair install.

translator-unmanaged.message: {translator} files are installed without an IndieDeck receipt.
translator-unmanaged.fix: Keep them, or back up and replace them through an IndieDeck install to make them managed.

translator-newer-than-registry.message: {translator} {installed} is newer than the newest release IndieDeck knows; it will be kept as is.

translator-version-unknown.message: {translator} files are present but their version cannot be read from disk or receipts.
translator-version-unknown.fix: Verify manually before any automatic replacement.

translator-receipt-corrupt.message: {count} IndieDeck receipt file(s) could not be trusted ({names}); automatic changes are blocked until this is resolved.

translator-version-conflict.message: {translator} {installed} does not fit this game's engine and backend combination as installed.
translator-version-conflict.fix: Run a repair install so the resolver picks a compatible build.

translator-update-available.message: {translator} {installed} is installed; a better-matching release for this game is available.

plan.loader-unavailable: No registered loader provides "{capability}" for this game.
plan.font-bundle-unresolved: A CJK fallback font is needed but no TMP bundle matches this Unity version - use the TextMeshPro 3.2+ system-font option instead.

font.not-unity: TMP fallback bundles apply to Unity games only.
font.no-target-need: No CJK fallback bundle is recommended for this target language.
font.not-tmp: TextMeshPro was not detected; this TMP bundle is not needed.
font.tmp-unknown: TextMeshPro detection is incomplete. Run a deep scan before choosing a TMP font.
font.unity-unknown: The Unity version is unknown, so a matching TMP bundle cannot be chosen safely.
font.no-matching-bundle: No registered TMP bundle matches Unity {unity} and this language.
font.installed: {file} is present and selected as the TMP fallback font. Runtime rendering still needs to be checked in the game.
font.recommended: {file} matches the registered Unity {unity} range. It supplies Korean, Japanese and Chinese fallback glyphs; test rendering in the game after installation.
font.translator-required: A single compatible installed XUnity.AutoTranslator variant and its loader are required before adding a font separately.

step.loader-manual: {loader} has no downloadable asset for {arch} - install it manually first ({url})
step.backup-managed: Snapshot the game assemblies before ReiPatcher rewrites them
step.run-setup: Run {exe} and then launch through the generated "(Patch and Run)" shortcut once
step.install-tool: Install {translator} into the IndieDeck tools folder
step.download-fonts: Download the TMP font bundle archive ({asset})
step.configure-font: Set only the TMP fallback font in {path} to {file}
step.write-config: Write {path} (created on first launch if missing)

warning.file-missing: {path} does not exist yet - it is generated the first time the game runs with the plugin installed. Values written now will be applied when it appears.
warning.version-unknown: The installed version could not be determined, so the newest known config layout is assumed.
warning.version-from-tag: Version {version} was read from the config's own Migrations tag, not from the installed assembly - treat it as a hint.

validation.assumed-mapping: {label} is being written to [{section}] {key}, assumed from the newest known layout because the installed version is unclear.
validation.unknown-provider: "{endpoint}" is not a provider IndieDeck knows about; its credential fields cannot be checked.
validation.provider-version: {provider} needs translator {min} or newer; {installed} is installed.
validation.missing-credential: {provider} needs {field}, which is not set. Translation will fail until it is.
validation.language-unsupported-source: {provider} does not list "{language}" as a source language{note}.
validation.language-unsupported-target: {provider} does not list "{language}" as a target language{note}.

invalid.engine: "{value}" is not a known translation engine.
invalid.language: "{value}" is not a language code (expected e.g. ko, ja, zh-CN).
invalid.font-bundle: "{value}" is not among the font bundles present in the game folder ({bundles}).

error.invalid-plan: Refusing to write an invalid config plan.
error.no-schema: No config schema is registered for "{translator}".
error.no-location: Could not work out where {translator} keeps its config in this game.

progress.preflight: Checking {translator} {version} against the current game folder
progress.rollback: Restoring the game folder after the failed step

error.no-roots: No library roots configured. Add one with `indiedeck root add <path>`.
error.no-match: No game matching "{query}" - run `indiedeck scan` first, or pass a folder path.
error.registry-missing: Could not locate the IndieDeck registry directory. Set INDIEDECK_REGISTRY to the folder holding engines.json.

help.scan: Scan roots for games and save the index
help.detect: Detect a folder without touching the library
help.check: Find broken setups: wrong TMP font for the Unity version, stacked loaders, orphaned plugin files, outdated translator versions
help.plan: Rank translator options with compatibility findings
help.install: Install the best plan (loader + translator + config)
help.config: Read or change translator settings by semantic id, checked against the version actually installed
help.uninstall: Remove what IndieDeck installed, restore backups
help.mods: List mods across every host, install one from a file, or toggle one
